recognize_zh: PD-L1 染色呈大片棕色網狀背景，主要來自組織球與細胞膜；大型腫瘤細胞核空泡狀、胞質相對較淡，周圍有膜狀染色輪廓；大細胞與組織球皆表現 PD-L1，符合 9p24.1 相關的免疫逃脫表型。
features: Diffuse moderate membranous and cytoplasmic PD-L1 staining forming a reticular brown network throughout the field
Large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei outlined by membranous staining, with relatively paler central cytoplasm
Intense staining in interspersed histiocytes/dendritic-appearing cells with branching cytoplasm
Small background lymphocyte nuclei largely unstained
describe_en: PD-L1 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining throughout the infiltrate, forming a reticular network. The large atypical cells show membranous outlining with relatively paler cytoplasm, and the surrounding histiocytes stain strongly; it is difficult in this field to separate tumor cell membranes from closely apposed histiocytic processes, so tumor-cell positivity is best confirmed with dual staining. PD-L1 expression by both neoplastic large cells and histiocytes is consistent with the immune-evasion phenotype (9p24.1/PD-L1 alteration) shared by classic Hodgkin lymphoma, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma and mediastinal gray zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: cHL HRS cells are also PD-L1 positive because of 9p24.1 amplification, so PD-L1 cannot separate them and B-cell markers (CD20, Oct-2) are needed.
PMBL frequently expresses PD-L1 too; distinction relies on monotonous morphology, strong CD20, CD23/MAL and absent CD15.
DLBCL NOS usually shows PD-L1 mainly in tumor-associated macrophages with negative tumor cells, apart from EBV-positive and non-GCB subsets.
